L1 REWORK · head `579f99aea70865d13f30d88948c4dc0a0c77354b` · 2026-11-22T11:30Z

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:所有「可编辑」的表格(对象视图自己画的表格、页面里手写的 object-grid)都和列表页一样,改为「先选中、再编辑」,改完一格立刻保存,不再出现「全部保存」那条栏。只读表格不变。元数据里的 `singleClickEdit` 作废,写了会报错并提示删掉,`os migrate meta` 能自动删。
- 为什么做:卡 #36270,按您的裁定 A「统一新编辑方式」(记录 7076617499)。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是有人写过 `singleClickEdit` 的页面升级后校验失败,要删掉这个键;本仓、hotcrm、gallery 里都没人写过。可以整体撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。
- 席位意见:REWORK,共 3 项,都是文字或流程,不动行为代码。实现、spec 退役套件和测试我读下来是对的,见下面。

## 要改的(3 项)

1. **PR 正文缺 `Skills-docs:` 一行。** 种类是 `narrowed`,又带 `(narrowing)`,按 L1 清单要有这一行,缺了就判 REWORK;`l1-face` 也标了。我在 head 上 `git grep` 过 `skills/`:没有任何地方提到 `singleClickEdit`、`keyboardNavigation`,也没有讲 object-grid 的编辑手势。所以写成 `Skills-docs: none — skills/ never names singleClickEdit, keyboardNavigation or object-grid's editing gestures (git grep at the head)` 就属实。只加在 PR 正文;changeset 里不用加。
2. **`@object-ui/types` 里 `ObjectGridSchema.keyboardNavigation` 的 TSDoc 和这次的收窄说法相反**(`ui/packages/types/src/objectql.ts:1385-1389`,本 PR 没改它)。它仍写着「`false` turns it off on an editable grid」。可是 changeset 写的是「`false` no longer turns it off there」,`data-table.tsx:1655` 的 `keyboardNavigationProp || selectFirst` 也是这样执行的。这个接口从包根导出,TSDoc 会进 dist 的 `.d.ts`,等于发布出去一句错的话(同 #36332 的先例)。请改成实际行为:可编辑表格默认是先选中模式,导航始终开着,`false` 不起作用;只有宿主传 `cellSelection={false}` 时,`false` 才关得掉。`ObjectGrid.tsx:3711-3718` 函数体里那段注释有同一句「an explicit `false` turns it off on an editable grid」,请一起改掉(它不进 `.d.ts`,但和第 3719 行的实际效果不符)。
3. **dogfood 要钉到最终 head。** 全量跑的那轮在 `1c2a16b9`(4175 条里 4107 过、0 失败),head `579f99ae` 只改了两段文档片段,这个说法我核过属实。但清单要求 `!` 或 `(narrowing)` 的 PR 要在 head 上有全量 battery,第 1、2 项改完 head 还会再动。所以请在最终 head 上重跑一次,写进正文的 `dogfood_battery`。

## 席位问的两件事

- **Clause-② 是不是应该写 `yes (narrowing)`?不是,`no (narrowing)` 是对的。** 这一行答的是「本卡有没有放宽接受集或扩大公开面」(`clause2-line.mjs` 文件头)。删掉一个已发布的键或导出,本身就是收窄,用 `(narrowing)` 这个分支表示,不让它变成 `yes`。只有同时还放宽了什么,才写 `yes (narrowing)`(#36351、#36319 的先例)。我逐项找过,这个 diff 里没有放宽的东西:没有新的 i18n 键(拒绝编辑的原因用的是已有的 `grid.readOnlyReason.*`),没有新的根导出(新增的 `export` 只在 conversion 和 migration 条目文件里,属于退役套件,不是包的公开面),没有新的参数(`cellSelection` 本来就有,这次只改了它缺省时的取值,属于行为变化,已经算在 `narrowed` 里)。裁定记录里写的 `yes (narrowing)` 是席位执行时的笔误,席位已经在 7077058264 里改回来了,changeset 和正文现在也都是 `no (narrowing)`。
- **dogfood 有没有钉到这个 head?没有**,见第 3 项。中间那次提交只改文档,所以结论我信得过;但按 `--land` 的规矩,要在最终 head 上重跑。

## 席位核对(本轮已读,增量时不重读)

- 形态:`l1-face --pr 36357` 只标了 skills-docs 和 dogfood 两项(上面第 1、3 项)。draft、base `main`、`Fixes #36270`;`check-governed-merges` 判定 NOT governed;60 个文件,改动 1,381 行。
- `Fixes` 对不对:卡上列的几种表格里,行为改在 `ObjectGrid` 一处(`hostCellSelection = cellSelectionProp ?? inlineEditable`),凡是经 `ObjectGrid` 画出来的可编辑表格都覆盖到了。相关列表从 #35684 起就是 `cellSelection` true。记录选择器(`RecordPickerDialog`)和设计器里的 `ObjectGrid` 都不传 `editable`,所以不变。仪表盘表格是 `ObjectDataTable` 直接画的 data-table,不经 `ObjectGrid`,本来就不能编辑。所以卡上「一个仪表盘表格」那个钉子没有可钉的东西;交付的两个钉子是对象视图表格和手写节点,各带只读对照。`Fixes` 可以成立。
- 声明:`Metadata-protocol: narrowed` 属实,删掉了一个可写的键。这个 PR 有两个 adr-0087 标记,都已登记,changeset 里也有,`check:adr-0087-registration` 已过。四个包都是 `minor`,和种类对得上。spec 删了键,`ui/` 的修复在同一个 PR 里,符合 AGENTS.md Post-Task 第 4 步,所以裁定里原定的「spec 先发一个 PR」合并成一个 PR 是对的。
- spec 退役套件:`retiredKey()` 墓碑、`RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[18]` 一行、D2 conversion(不管键的值是什么都删,范围包括顶层 regions、嵌套 `children` 和具名槽位)、D3 条目、STEP18 理由、ledger `page.json` 的 [122] 和收窄后的 [43]、两个 pin 测试、`retired-key-removal-version` 的 JOIN 一行,都在。`@object-ui/types` 那边是 `?: never` 加 `retirementTombstone()` 两个孪生,`object-view` 的 `table` 槽位继承墓碑;`DataTableSchema.singleClickEdit` 是宿主在代码里设的,不动,这是对的。
- 行为代码:`ObjectGrid.tsx` 只有一处行为改动。`singleClickEdit: true` 改成无条件传入:在先选中模式下这个值不起作用;宿主传 `false` 走暂存模式时,它就是旧键原来的默认值。传给 data-table 的 `keyboardNavigation` 没改,先选中模式下由 data-table 强制打开(`:1655`)。
- 文本逐句核:changeset 和 `component.mdx`、`plugins.mdx`、`plugin-grid.mdx` / README、`plugin-view.mdx` / README 逐句读过,除了第 2 项那两处都和 diff 一致。`plugin-grid.mdx` 的「`false` does not turn it off there」没提宿主传 `cellSelection={false}` 这个例外;后面「Batch Editing」一节已经讲了这条路,所以不改判。
- 测试证据:报告里的消融是把 `cellSelectionProp ?? inlineEditable` 改回 `cellSelectionProp`,6 条里挂 3 条,3 条对照仍绿。`keyboardNavigation-11068` 改成钉「可编辑表格上 `false` 不起作用」,另有宿主 `false` 的对照。25 个暂存路径的文件改成传 `cellSelection={false}`。我没有在本地重跑,读的是报告和 CI。
- CI @ `579f99ae`:63 success · 11 expected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending;mergeable_state clean。
- 和 #36332 的重叠:正文写了后落地的那个要对另一个的 head 重跑 overlap-check;席位说当前是干净的。
- 落地条款:非受管的收窄,按先例由席位在 dogfood 钉到 head 后用 `--land` 落地。这三项改完我做增量 L1,只核正文的 `Skills-docs:` 行、两处 TSDoc/注释和 dogfood 那一行,外加 CI。

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `579f99aea70865d13f30d88948c4dc0a0c77354b`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/conversions/entries/18/object-grid-single-click-edit-removed.ts, packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/retired-keys/18.ui__ObjectGridProps__singleClickEdit.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.object-grid-single-click-edit-retired.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template, packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts + ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/index.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx, ui/packages/types/src/objectql.ts, ui/packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts

Inputs read: card #36270 with its six comments (ruling 7076617499, claims 7076019035, 7076656125 and 7077058264, report 7078389795), PR #36357 body and its one comment, the net diff of 60 files against merge-base `3faabd26`, and the 74 check-runs on the head (63 success, 11 skipped, none failed). Code outside the diff was read at the head, not reviewed.

### ① Derived judgments

- `@objectstack/spec`, `object-grid` `properties.singleClickEdit`: accepted `true` and `false` before, refused now by a `retiredKey()` tombstone that carries the prescription. Right. This is ruling 7076617499 item 2.
- `@objectstack/spec`, `object-grid` `properties.keyboardNavigation`: the accept set is unchanged. The describe now says the navigation is always on for a grid that renders editable. Right. The data table forces it under the select-first model (`keyboardNavigation = keyboardNavigationProp || selectFirst`), so the describe matches the code.
- `@object-ui/types`, `ObjectGridSchema.singleClickEdit`: `boolean` becomes `never`, and the zod twin refuses every value by name. The `object-view` `table` slot inherits the tombstone. Right. The member stays on the type, as `resizableColumns` did.
- `@object-ui/plugin-grid`: the `object-grid` registration loses the `singleClickEdit` input, and `ObjectGrid` no longer reads the key. An absent `cellSelection` now follows `inlineEditable`. Right against the ruling. `inlineEditable` is the authored `editable` and the object's inline-edit verdict, so a read-only grid keeps click-to-open.
- `@object-ui/plugin-view`: `table.singleClickEdit` leaves `OBJECT_VIEW_TABLE_RELAY_KEYS`. That list is exported from `ObjectView.tsx` only. The package entry does not publish it, so no published name changes.
- Registries: conversion `object-grid-single-click-edit-removed` at `MAJOR_18` order 83 (unique), retired-keys row `ui/ObjectGridProps:singleClickEdit`, D3 entry `object-grid-single-click-edit-retired` that names the conversion, `STEP18_RATIONALE` order 123 (unique), and the surface baseline line marked `[RETIRED]`. All five name the one key the schema retires.
- No published export leaves a package entry, no type member is deleted, and nothing in the diff widens an accept set or adds a public name.

### ② Semver level

- The changeset moves `@objectstack/spec`, `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/plugin-view`, each at `minor`. `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` asks for at least `minor` on a package the diff moves. The levels hold.
- The break is marked three ways: the `!` in the title, the `**BREAKING**` banner in the changeset, and a FROM and TO table with three rows. The `adr-0087: registered` line names both ids, and both exist in the tree under those ids.
- The tombstone says the key was removed in 18.7.0 and the conversion says `retiredAfter: '18.6.0'`. `packages/spec/package.json` is at 18.6.0, so a minor lands on 18.7.0. The removal-version pin test joins the new conversion and `Test Core` is green.
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` is the right line. I checked the arm rather than trusting it. No published export or type member is removed: `singleClickEdit` stays on `ObjectGridSchema` as `never`, and the relay list is not on a package entry. Nothing widens, so there is no widening to name in a tail. The ruling's text wrote `yes (narrowing)` for a separate spec PR. The tree does not support `yes`.
- `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` is right. A key is tombstoned (`narrowed`) and one default changes meaning (`semantic`). `narrowed` takes precedence.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The report carries `open_questions: []`, `security_findings: none` and `out_of_scope_findings: []`. There is no dev flag to answer.
- SQL push-down: the diff adds no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join. The per-cell save is the existing `defaultRowSave`, one `dataSource.update` per record.
- Upgrade message. A page that still writes the key fails the parse with the prescription, on both the spec face and the `@object-ui/types` face. `os migrate meta --from 17` strips it through `stripKeys`, which emits one notice per site. The fixture expects four notices for four sites. No value is dropped without a message.
- The ruling asked for a spec PR first and then the grid PR. The work is one PR. Claim 7077058264 records this. One merge satisfies the order, so I accept the deviation.
- S1 (should-fix) — the dogfood battery is not pinned to this head. The report field reads `579f99ae suites on 1c2a16b9`. The suites ran on `1c2a16b9`. The head `579f99ae` is a one-parent commit above it, not a merge of the base. The rule accepts the head, or a commit below it over merges of the base only. The leading sha names the head, so a reader that judges the sha alone reads "ran on the head". I verified that `579f99ae` changes two prose files only (`content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx` and `ui/packages/plugin-grid/README.md`), so the risk is small. The dogfood shards in CI were skipped on this head, so the local battery is the only run. To clear: run the battery on `579f99ae` and post a corrected report. The head does not move.
- S2 (should-fix) — the card's Done-when is not accounted for. The card names five grid families and asks for two pins with ablations, one related list and one dashboard table. Its two "Read first" questions are answered nowhere in the PR body or the report. My reading at the head follows. The object-view grid and the authored `object-grid` node change here, with pins and an ablation. The related tab already passes `cellSelection: true` (`RelatedList.tsx`, pinned by `RelatedList.tab-35892.test.tsx`). The record picker and the designer grids render `ObjectGrid` without `editable`, so they are read-only and unchanged. Dashboard tables are `data-table` and `object-data-table` nodes, not `ObjectGrid`. They have no save path, and a bare `data-table` that is handed `editable` still stages edits and draws the bar. So every grid that renders editable through `ObjectGrid` selects a cell first, and no in-repo host passes `cellSelection` as `false`. The PR should say this, and say that the dashboard-table pin has no subject. This is a PR-body fix. The head does not move.

### ④ Design judgment

- `component.zod.ts`: holds. The tombstone text matches the model in `data-table.tsx`, where a click selects under `selectFirst` and the `singleClickEdit` branches are never reached. The narrowed `keyboardNavigation` describe is what the code enforces. The first consumer, `ObjectGrid`, no longer reads the key.
- `object-grid-single-click-edit-removed.ts`: holds. The strip is scoped by component type and reaches regions, nested `children` and named slots through `mapPageComponents`. The fixture has a control for the same key name on another component and for a grid without the key. A delete is lossless here, because neither value can be honoured.
- `conversions/registry.ts`, the retired-keys entry and `registry.ts.template`: hold. Ids, order numbers and the rationale agree with the schema and with each other.
- `18.object-grid-single-click-edit-retired.ts`: holds. It names what the conversion cannot decide, including the `keyboardNavigation: false` case. It carries no relevance question, so `os migrate meta` always prints it.
- `ObjectGrid.tsx`: the hunk does what the contract says. `hostCellSelection = cellSelectionProp ?? inlineEditable` is computed before every reader of it. The grid always hands the table `onRowSave ?? defaultRowSave`, so `autosaves` is true and the pending bar and "Save All" are not drawn.
- S3 (should-fix) — a React host's own `onBatchSave` is bypassed without a word. `ObjectGrid` is a published component and `onBatchSave` is a published prop. A host that renders an editable grid, passes `onBatchSave` alone and passes no `cellSelection` used to get its handler called from "Save All". After this change the grid is select-first, each cell saves through `defaultRowSave`, and the write goes straight to `dataSource.update`. The host's handler is never called, and nothing says so. The data table's own guard (a select-first table wired with `onBatchSave` alone keeps the staged bar) cannot fire, because `ObjectGrid` always supplies `onRowSave`. No in-repo host passes `onBatchSave`, so this reaches outside hosts only. The changeset's FROM and TO table has no row for it. To clear: add the row (pass `onRowSave`, or pass `cellSelection` as `false`), or keep the staged model when a host supplies `onBatchSave` without `onRowSave`.
- `index.tsx`, `ObjectView.tsx`, `objectql.ts`, `objectql.zod.ts`: agree with the contract, sentence by sentence.
- Nit: two comments in `ObjectGrid.tsx` outside the hunks are now stale. The comment above `keyboardNavigation:` still says an explicit `false` turns the navigation off on an editable grid. The host-key list near line 588 still names `singleClickEdit`.
- Nit: an authored `keyboardNavigation: false` on an editable grid is now inert, and no notice names the site. The D3 entry and the step-18 rationale say it, which is enough for the ruling's wording.
